messages:
olivia: Anyone else seeing intermittent 503s from eu-proxy -> ingest? Started ~09:12 UTC after the cert redeploy.
kevin: Yep. Proxy logs show `SNI assertion failed: subjectAltName mismatch`. Also seeing KMS errors: `decrypt denied` against /keystore/eu/provisioner/wrapped-key.
sec-bot: ALERT: 3 decrypt_denied events from eu1 for service=cert-provisioner (role=service-certwriter).
maria: I think the RBAC cleanup yesterday removed the cert-writer binding from the provisioner service account.
sam: Confirmed. IAM change iam-change-2026-03-19 by sarah removed roles/service-certwriter from serviceAccount:provisioner@redwood.iam.
kevin: That would explain the provisioner failing to unwrap private keys -> stale certchains served -> SNI mismatch.
olivia: We need a fast mitigation. Options: 1) rebind role, 2) fallback edge certchain override, 3) reissue certs from an alternate keystore.
sre-oncall: I can request a temporary KMS policy binding (needs infra-ks-admin approval). Which is fastest?
maria: Rebinding is fastest if Sarah can re-add. But we should also patch the rotator to fail open gracefully (serve fallback chain) for short TTL.
sam: I'll prepare an audit rule to alert on any future role removals that touch KMS keys (console rule + slackhook). Link: https://console.redwood/iam/policies (will post).
kevin: Manual mitigation documented in runbook now. Snippet to rebind: ```gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/redwood/locations/europe/KeyRings/eu-keystore/cryptoKeys/provisioner-key --member=serviceAccount:provisioner@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter```
olivia: If someone can re-add the role, we'll watch for KMS decrypt success events and then rotate the affected certs. Also run the keystore-consistency check.
maria: Running backfill checklist: `scripts/keystore/find_decrypt_denied --region eu --since 09:00` then tag impacted cert IDs and queue reissue.
sarah: I pushed the change, didn’t realize the provisioner still depended on that role. Re-added roles/service-certwriter to provisioner SA and requested the KMS binding reapply. Verifying now.
sec-bot: EVENT: 12 decrypt_allowed events detected for provisioner@redwood.iam in eu1 in the last 2m.
kevin: Good sign. Start rolling reissued certs to ingest cluster. Use `ingest/edge-config override certchain=eu-fallback-2026-03-19` as temporary if any nodes still fail.
sre-oncall: I've opened infra ticket INFRA-1428 to formalize a preflight check: "RBAC change touches KMS keys -> must run KMS-binding-compat check + runbook approval".
maria: I'll own the postmortem and remediation: add RBAC-to-key ownership map, automated preflight, and ensure rotator can fallback safely.
olivia: Thanks. After PM we'll add regression alert to catch SNI assertion errors tied to decrypt_denied events. :thumbsup:
